title: The Problem with "Jesus Saved the World"

top_liked.author: @hannahhodgins9516
top_liked.text: The fact that we even need to be “saved” is silly

top_liked.author: @Chris-op7yt
top_liked.text: i was saved when i de-converted.

top_liked.author: @jlee3925
top_liked.text: We need to be saved from the way God created us in the first place? Makes no sense at all.

top_liked.author: @johnfox9169
top_liked.text: By age 8, I "knew " there was something fishy about the religious "education " I was receiving in Sunday school.  Soon, I turned atheist.  I have learned a decent amount about the psychology and history of religions. It often comes down to the fear and unpleasantness of death.

top_liked.author: @archie-pelago
top_liked.text: The devil was supposedly defeated but someone forgot to inform him 😂

top_liked.author: @bbellefson
top_liked.text: You shredded THE CORE mythology here (like one of those shredders that eats engine blocks)!

top_liked.author: @SilortheBlade
top_liked.text:
Jesus defeated Sin, but Thor defeated all the frost giants.

I still see sin everywhere, but when it is the last time you saw a frost giant?

top_liked.author: @AubreyLeoneDoLofonos4747
top_liked.text: Excellent points. People rattle off these claims as if in some way they are self evident, but you can't begin to get there without first accepting absurd presuppositions. It demonstrates the deep indoctrination level so many of us found ourselves in. It once seemed so real to…

top_liked.author: @AubreyLeoneDoLofonos4747
top_liked.text: Jesus does it all ... in the sweet by and by ... you'll see....  Jesus just can't do anything in reality. ... Just can't figure out reality...

top_liked.author: @theresemalmberg955
top_liked.text: It's like the fire department arriving at a house that is fully engaged, throwing a little water on it, and then telling people the fire is out while it is still raging.
